title: Patient Payment Plans Add-On Fee: Schedule of Add-On Number Shares
content:
The add-on fee charged on a Patient Payment Plans plan carries an add-on number share according to how many add-on enrollment entries the plan carries over its life.

| Add-on enrollment entries on the plan over its life | Add-on number share |
|---|---|
| Exactly one (the add-on being charged is its first) | 0.50 |
| Exactly two | 0.75 |
| Three or more | 1 |

**Schedule rule.** The add-on number share of the fee is 0.50 when the plan carries exactly one add-on enrollment entry over its life (the add-on being charged is its first), 0.75 when it carries exactly two, and 1 when it carries three or more. The count includes the add-on enrollment entry being charged. The share multiplies the tier's setup fee within the scheduled add-on fee, acting on the tier's setup fee itself; the scheduled add-on fee is carried unrounded until the fee is entered.

**Record read.** The add-on enrollment entries on the plan's ledger, counted entry by entry.

**Figures (hypothetical tier setup fee of 40.00, this share alone).** First add-on: 20.00. Second add-on: 30.00. Third add-on: 40.00.
